text: At its meeting on September 24, 2020, the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee considered Item DI10.2, Access and Waiting Areas at City Hall for People with Disabilities - Update.

City Council on November 25 and 26, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the Deputy City Manager, Corporate Services to hold public consultations with specific outreach to people with disabilities regarding decisions on any proposed public safety and security measures at City facilities that would impact access and accessibility, including changes to any waiting areas or bus shelters at City Hall or other locations that are used by Toronto Transit Commission Wheel-Trans or other customers with disabilities, and to report back to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee in the first quarter of 2021.
